daily_driver_policy.method: Evidence-based daily-driver decision matrix; no master score or numeric rank
daily_driver_policy.recommendation_confidence: provisional, benchmark-backed recommendation for this rig; not long-term stability certification
daily_driver_policy.coverage_policy: Use every tested family; never mix Gyro-S rc1 sampled suites into rc2 evidence, impute missing data, double-count shared per-file samples as effort repetitions, or equate tool warnings with safety certification. TPS stays in separate diagnostics.
daily_driver_policy.deployment_policy: A capability result alone cannot override observed memory, campaign-validity, safety-gate and matched-coverage caveats. Existing stock evidence is preferred over experimental fork-only wins for the default recommendation. This report does not change the deployed model.

recommendations.reason: Scored quality is useful, but narrow 16 GB memory margin, raw safety-gate failures, CTest/campaign caveats and the slowest total wall (172m at xhigh) prevent a daily-driver endorsement.

analysis_only_axes.reason: Gyro-S valid rc2 math, instructions, debugging, retrieval and algebra are imported. Legacy rc1 artifacts are archived, not substituted.

gyro_m_speed_attribution.reason: The client targeted 127.0.0.1:8090/v1, while the retained Gyro-M Strata start command configured port 8080; the available router evidence is 8081->8080, and no 8090-to-engine route or engine-side request log was retained. Preserve the raw endpoint numbers, but do not attribute any depth to the pinned Gyro-M setup or use it for comparison.

human_eval_plus.token_rate_caveat: Provider-reported completion usage includes hidden reasoning tokens; not visible-text throughput or local engine decode speed.
